entries.zh: 遭遇、碰到（多指遭逢不测之事）
entries.en: to meet with, encounter (often misfortune)
entries.notes: R 栏音写与「遭」字对音不合（疑误读），释义据 L/H/M 三栏互证

entries.zh: 触犯、冒犯；撞上、遭逢（犯著）
entries.en: to offend, violate; to run into, encounter

entries.zh: 恰好、适逢（恰好遇上）；适宜
entries.en: just then, exactly; to chance to meet; to fit, suit

entries.zh: 碰、触撞（撞上）；触犯
entries.en: to strike against, touch; to bump into (stumble upon)

entries.zh: 撞、碰撞（迎面撞上）
entries.en: to knock against, collide with; to run into

entries.zh: 避开、躲避（「避」字本义；与西语 en contrar acaso「偶然遇上」义不相合，释义存疑）
entries.en: to avoid, shun (per the character; the Spanish 'to chance upon' does not agree - uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字「避」（避开）与西语「偶然遇上」义及 M/R 栏音写均难吻合，释义存疑

entries.zh: 磕、磕碰（迎头撞上）
entries.en: to knock against, strike head-on
entries.notes: M 栏首音标记号 T99 污损难辨，据 H「磕」与 R 栏定释义

entries.zh: 相争、竞抗（两相抵触）；竞
entries.en: to contend, vie against one another; to clash
entries.notes: M 栏音写与第 15 条完全相同而本条汉字仅作「競」，释义取竞争/相抵义，存疑

entries.zh: （两物）相向冲撞；顶撞、抵触（contradezir＝相互抵牾）
entries.en: (of two things) to rush and meet one against the other; to contradict, gainsay
entries.notes: 汉字栏带 [疑:衝/衡] 标记，按「衝」取相撞抵触义（与西语 contradezir 亦相合）

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑为遭逢忧苦；「瀆」字本义为亵渎、玷污
entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕(character 瀆) to profane, defile; the Spanish fragment suggests 'to meet with sorrow'
entries.notes: 西语栏有 [残]，且 H 瀆 / M / R 三栏读音互不吻合，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 遇到、遇上（遇著）
entries.en: to meet with, come upon

entries.zh: 遇见、相见（彼此照面）
entries.en: to meet, see each other

entries.zh: 撞上、撞著
entries.en: to run into, bump into
entries.notes: M 栏首音标记号 T99 污损难辨，据 H「撞著」与 R 栏定释义

entries.zh: 磕上、磕碰著
entries.en: to knock against, bump into
entries.notes: M 栏首音标记号 T99 污损难辨，据 H「磕著」与 R 栏定释义

entries.zh: 競手〔组合罕见，疑为出手相抵、推搪〕
entries.en: to push / strike hand against hand (uncertain compound)
entries.notes: 「競手」词义罕见且 M/R 两栏第二音节写法互异，仅按「競＋手」字面推为以手相抵，存疑

entries.zh: 磕著东磕著西（东碰西磕、四处乱撞）
entries.en: to knock now east, now west; to blunder about bumping into things
entries.notes: M 栏两处音标记号 T99 污损，据 H/R 逐字对读定释义

entries.zh: 磕著前磕著后（前后磕碰、到处撞上）
entries.en: to knock now in front, now behind; to keep bumping into things
entries.notes: M 栏两处音标记号 T99 污损，据 H/R 逐字对读定释义

entries.zh: 妨碍人、碍人事（与人相碍）
entries.en: to hinder, obstruct people
entries.notes: 西语栏缩写 grae.（疑为 grandes/graves）展开依赖推断，释义主要据 H「碍人」与 R 栏（碍）

entries.zh: 干犯、冒渎（与人相干犯）
entries.en: to offend, encroach upon another (to run against someone in something)

entries.zh: 干及、牵涉（干涉及于他人）
entries.en: to touch upon, involve another; to interfere with

entries.zh: 干碍、妨碍（与人相碍）
entries.en: to obstruct, stand in the way of another
